can: Consigo falar sobre meus hábitos alimentares e minha rotina, diferenciar o que faço sempre do que estou fazendo agora, e reagir com naturalidade ao que outra pessoa conta.

lessons.title: Food and cooking
lessons.goal: Ter o vocabulário para falar do que você come, como prepara e onde come.

head: Grupo
Palavras
rows: Fish and seafood (peixes e frutos do mar)
salmon (salmão), tuna (atum), shrimp (camarão; prawns é o camarão grande), squid (lula)
cabbage (repolho), cucumber (pepino), pepper (pimentão), green beans (vagem), onion (cebola)

aula.text: **Adjetivos de comida:** fresh (fresco), frozen (congelado), spicy / hot (apimentado), raw (cru), low-fat (light), canned (enlatado).

items: **eat out** = comer fora. *We eat out every Friday.*
**cut down on** = reduzir. *I'm cutting down on sugar.*
**cut out** = cortar totalmente. *My doctor told me to cut out fried food.*

aula.label: Erro comum de brasileiro
aula.text: "I'm going to *take* lunch" não existe. O certo é **have lunch** (have breakfast, have dinner, have a coffee).

exercises.prompt: I never eat sushi because I don't like ___ fish. (cru)
I'm trying to cut ___ ___ coffee. Just one cup a day now.
Yesterday I took dinner with my family.
acc: Yesterday I had dinner with my family

exercises.prompt: Qual a diferença: roast chicken x grilled chicken?
exercises.ref: roast = assado no forno com gordura; grilled = na grelha.

exercises.prompt: Escreva 2 frases sobre o que você comeu ontem usando uma forma de preparo.
exercises.note: A correção desta resposta pelo professor IA chega na etapa 3.

chat.scenario: Um pesquisador faz um questionário sobre hábitos alimentares.
chat.role: Entrevistador simpático de uma pesquisa sobre comida.
chat.guide: O que você costuma comer no café da manhã; com que frequência come fora; que comida você não vive sem; se está tentando reduzir alguma coisa; como prefere ovos, frango e batata.
chat.goal: Usar pelo menos 6 palavras da aula e 1 phrasal verb.

en.gram: Food vocabulary (food groups, cooking methods, food adjectives), the phrasal verbs eat out / cut down on / cut out, and the present simple for habits
en.vocab: beef, chicken, pork, lamb, salmon, tuna, shrimp, squid, cabbage, cucumber, pepper, onion, green beans, grapes, peach, pear, mango, cherries, milk, cheese, butter, yogurt; fried, grilled, boiled, roast, baked, steamed; fresh, frozen, spicy, raw, low-fat, canned; eat out, cut down on, cut out; have breakfast / lunch / dinner
en.scenario: A researcher is doing a survey about eating habits. The student answers the questions.
en.role: A friendly interviewer for a food habits survey. Topics, one at a time: what he usually has for breakfast; how often he eats out; the food he cannot live without; whether he is trying to cut down on something; how he likes eggs, chicken and potatoes.
en.goal: Use at least 6 words from the lesson and 1 phrasal verb.

lessons.title: Present simple x present continuous
lessons.goal: Separar o que é hábito do que está acontecendo agora ou neste período.

head: Present simple
Present continuous
rows: Ação agora ou temporária (esta semana, este mês)
usually, always, every day, once a week
now, at the moment, this week, these days
I usually have coffee for breakfast.
I'm having tea this week. I'm out of coffee.

aula.text: **Verbos de estado (non-action verbs)** quase nunca vão para o continuous, mesmo falando de agora:

items: Sentimentos: like, love, hate, want, need, prefer
Pensamento: know, believe, understand, remember, think (= achar)
Sentidos e aparência: taste, smell, seem, look (= parecer)

aula.text: *I need a coffee now.* (e não *I'm needing*)

items: **have:** *I have a car* (posse, simple) x *I'm having lunch* (comer, continuous)
**think:** *I think it's good* (opinião, simple) x *I'm thinking about dinner* (pensar em, continuous)

aula.label: Erro comum de brasileiro
aula.text: "I am liking this food." O certo é **I like this food** ou **I'm enjoying this food**. Enjoy é exceção e aceita continuous.

exercises.prompt: My mother ___ (cook) dinner right now. It ___ (smell) amazing.
I ___ (not eat) meat. I'm a vegetarian.
This week I ___ (try) to eat less sugar.
I'm knowing a good restaurant near here.
acc: I know a good restaurant near here

exercises.prompt: Every Sunday I'm having lunch with my parents.
acc: Every Sunday I have lunch with my parents

chat.scenario: Você é um jornalista entrevistando um chef de cozinha.
chat.role: Chef de um restaurante pequeno, que responde e devolve perguntas sobre a sua rotina.
chat.guide: Rotina do chef num dia normal; o que ele está preparando de novo esta semana; o que você costuma cozinhar; o que você está tentando mudar na alimentação agora.
chat.goal: Usar os dois tempos verbais corretamente e pelo menos 2 verbos de estado.

en.gram: Present simple (habits, routines, facts) versus present continuous (now, or a temporary period); state verbs (need, want, like, love, prefer, know, understand) are not used in the continuous
en.vocab: usually, always, every day, once a week, right now, at the moment, these days, this week; state verbs: need, want, like, love, prefer, know, understand; food and cooking words from lesson 1
en.scenario: The student is a journalist interviewing a chef.
en.role: A chef at a small restaurant who answers the questions and also asks the student about his own routine. Topics, one at a time: the chef's routine on a normal day; what he is preparing that is new this week; what the student usually cooks; what the student is trying to change in his diet right now.
en.goal: Use both tenses correctly and at least 2 state verbs.

lessons.title: Inglês prático: apresentar e reagir
lessons.goal: Se apresentar, apresentar outra pessoa e reagir ao que alguém conta sem travar a conversa.

items: Hi, I'm Alexandre. Nice to meet you.
This is my friend Paula. Paula, this is Mark.
It's so nice to finally meet you.

aula.text: Reagir ao que os outros dizem

head: Notícia
Reações
rows: What a pity. / Never mind. / Oh no!
I'm so sorry to hear that. / That's awful.
How interesting! / Oh, really? Tell me more.

aula.text: **Regra:** How + adjetivo (*How awful!*), What + substantivo (*What a pity!*, *What a great idea!*).

aula.label: Cuidado
aula.text: Never mind e What a pity só servem para problemas pequenos. Para algo grave, use *I'm so sorry to hear that*.
Pedir desculpas (usado na conversa desta lição)

items: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
I'm really sorry, I forgot the dessert.
Resposta comum: Don't worry about it. / No problem.

options: I'm so sorry to hear that.
I'm so sorry to hear that.
I'm so sorry to hear that.
I'm so sorry to hear that.

exercises.instr: Complete com um adjetivo (qualquer adjetivo serve):

chat.scenario: Você chega atrasado para um jantar na casa dos pais de um amigo e esqueceu a sobremesa que ia levar.
chat.role: O anfitrião, que conta várias notícias durante o jantar (boas, ruins e surpreendentes).
chat.goal: Se apresentar, pedir desculpas pelo atraso e reagir corretamente a pelo menos 4 notícias.

en.gram: Introducing yourself and other people; reacting to news (How + adjective, What + noun); apologizing
en.vocab: Nice to meet you; This is ...; That's great! / Congratulations! / What a pity. / Never mind. / Oh no! / I'm so sorry to hear that. / That's awful. / Really? / You're kidding! / No way! / How interesting!; Sorry I'm late; I'm really sorry, I forgot the dessert; Don't worry about it.
en.scenario: The student arrives late to dinner at his friend's parents' house and forgot the dessert he was going to bring.
en.role: The host, who tells the student several pieces of news during dinner (good, bad, serious and surprising), one at a time, and waits for his reaction.
en.goal: Introduce himself, apologize for being late and react correctly to at least 4 news items.

lessons.title: Revisão e teste de saída
lessons.goal: Para passar para a Unidade 2: 80% no teste escrito e nota 7 ou mais na conversa final.

test.prompt: Vegetables cooked over hot water are ___.
Food that is not cooked is ___.
I want to lose weight, so I'm cutting ___ ___ bread.
I am wanting a pizza tonight.

test.instr: Alguém diz: "I passed my driving test!" Reaja.
Alguém diz: "I spilled coffee on my shirt." Reaja.

chat.scenario: Debate sobre afirmações polêmicas sobre comida.
chat.role: Colega de debate que lê uma afirmação por vez e discorda de você de propósito.
chat.guide: "Eating out is a waste of money." / "Fast food is getting healthier." / "Everyone should learn to cook."
chat.goal: Dar opinião com razões, usar os dois tempos verbais e o vocabulário da unidade.
chat.turns: a IA dá a nota no relatório final; 7 ou mais aprova

en.gram: Mixed review of the unit: present simple versus present continuous, food vocabulary, and giving opinions with reasons
en.vocab: All the vocabulary of Unit 1 (food groups, cooking methods, eat out / cut down on / cut out) and opinion phrases: I think, in my opinion, I agree, I disagree, because
en.scenario: A debate about controversial statements on food.
en.role: A debate colleague who reads one statement at a time and disagrees with the student on purpose, asking him to justify his opinion. The statements, in order: "Eating out is a waste of money." / "Fast food is getting healthier." / "Everyone should learn to cook." Start with the first one.
en.goal: Give opinions with reasons, use both tenses and the unit vocabulary. This is the exit test: grade strictly, 7 or more means the student passes.

debate.label: Dar opinião
debate.text: I think... / In my opinion... / I don't think...

debate.label: Concordar
debate.text: I agree. / That's true. / You're right.

debate.label: Discordar
debate.text: I don't agree. / I'm not sure about that. / I see your point, but...
